plan: My value is $25. Since this is a single round, I want to win if my value is higher than the second-highest value. I'll bid slightly above what I estimate the others will bid. Assuming a uniform distribution of values, the expected second-highest bid is around $16.67 (a rough estimate). To ensure a win with a good profit margin, I'll bid $17.50. This is aggressive, but reasonable given the single-round nature.

Given my value is $17, I want to win if possible, but avoid overpaying. Since it's round 1 and we have no history, I'll assume opponents bid somewhat randomly. A conservative bid around 60-70% of my value seems reasonable. I'll bid $10.30. This aims to win against likely low bids, while protecting me from significantly overpaying if others bid aggressively. If others bid lower, I win cheaply. If they bid higher, I lose a small amount.
